# Native run

A fresh Developer scratch org with a 30-day duration had no features or settings.
Anonymous Apex ran at API 62.0 and 67.0 on 2026-11-14 from 13:33:16 to
13:33:55 UTC using Salesforce CLI 2.157.8.

The probes reported global describe membership, `Type.forName`, and dynamic
`SELECT Id LIMIT 1` in assertion messages. `org.tsv` transcribes those results.
The scratch org was deleted and deletion was verified.
